## Your report

Everything you answer in the Theory Drills (on the [Theory Drills](theory/theory-drills.qmd) page and every chapter page) and in
[Chord Analysis](theory/chord-analysis.qmd) is recorded in this browser: each question, every answer you gave, right or wrong, how long
it took, and the hints and answers you looked at. Type your name, choose **Today** or **Everything**, then **Print or save as PDF**, or
**Copy the report** to paste it into an assignment. Nothing is sent anywhere, and a different browser or computer has its own record.

The same report opens from the **My report** button on every exercise.

<div id="sr-mine"></div>

```{=html}
<script>
(function go() { if (!window.SiteRecord) return setTimeout(go, 50); SiteRecord.panel(document.getElementById("sr-mine")); })();
</script>
```

## For teachers: check a report

A copied report ends with a **report code**. Paste it here: the page rebuilds the report from the code, shows every answer (a student's
own copy shows an answer only once they found it or asked to see it), and says whether the report was changed after it was made.
The check stops casual edits; it is not a secure signature.

<div class="sr-check"></div>
